ITZY - Mawazine Festival 2026 [Live in Morocco] (2160p 4K)​


​
The 21st edition of the Mawazine Festival took place in Rabat and Salé, Morocco, from June 19 to June 27, 2026. The event drew 3.6 million attendees, featuring major headliners like Tiësto, ITZY, Tyga, Tyla, and Ninho. This year's festival overlapped with the 2026 FIFA World Cup, utilizing a special partnership with beIN Sports to broadcast matches on-site.
